dedupe_keys.name: kinematic model for the cme deflection in interplanetary space

description: DIPS estimates deflection of a coronal-mass-ejection trajectory within the ecliptic plane. Its kinematic method relates the deflection direction to differences between eruption and background solar-wind velocities. The resource is documented by USTC. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The two-dimensional construction does not represent arbitrary three-dimensional event geometry. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
